narrative: Automate 2026's first-time NVIDIA-sponsored Humanoid Pavilion packs over twenty platforms into one venue, with the chip-and-cloud backer staking the marquee floor. A field that dense competing for the same compute partners is precisely the structural pressure that pulls a rival maker toward a large strategic round, even though sponsorship is visibility, not capital.
remaining_gap: No humanoid maker has been reported closing a $500M-plus chip-and-cloud round; pavilion sponsorship is event marketing, not a disclosed equity commitment.
